template_meta.title: Equipment / Resource Rental
template_meta.description: A setup for multi-day bookings like equipment rentals, rooms, or vehicles. Clients select a date range instead of a time slot.

clisyc_resource.post_content: Includes a mirrorless camera body, 24-70mm f/2.8 lens, tripod, and two batteries. Billed per day.
A 2000W portable generator available for daily rental.
